Name: FS - Backpacks and Baubles
Author: PeacefulEnd
Description:
[img]https://imgur.com/NfzZXD5.png[/img][size=3]﻿
Backpacks and Baubles is a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url] pack which adds several animated and recolorable backpack accessories via the [url=https://github.com/Floogen/FashionSense/wiki/Hand-Mirror-Tool]Hand Mirror[/url] tool. Some backpacks also give off light via an attached lamp!
[/size]

[img]https://imgur.com/GyuRdl9.png[/img]﻿
[img]https://imgur.com/8veKKM4.gif[/img]﻿


[size=6][b]Inventory Based Backpacks[/b][/size]
These backpacks change size depending on the current amount of items in your inventory.

[b][size=3]How do I wear one of these backpacks?[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][size=3]Use the Hand Mirror tool from the Fashion Sense framework and select the "accessories" button.[/size]
[/list]
